quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road is crossing a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road is crossing a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guard rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It warns that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means no U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and cross traffic go first. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign tells you there is a fire station nearby. Watch for emergency vehicles on the road.

questions.question: This is a:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black symbols. They warn drivers about special situations or hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped warning sign has a yellow background with black markings. It tells you a steep hill is coming. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and dangers. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. You should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging onto the road from the left.
Right lane ends ahead. Merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead. Merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending. You must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is coming. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a divider in the middle. Stay on the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is prohibited. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Workers are on or near the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the road. Drive with extra care in work zones.

questions.question: What is the correct order of colors on a traffic light from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic lights, red is always on top and green is always on bottom. On horizontal lights, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fines are doubled in work zones.
questions.explanation: Work zones are dangerous for both drivers and workers. Orange signs warn you about construction zones. This sign tells you that penalties for careless driving in work zones are twice as high.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if you are in the right lane.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes going the same direction are about to become one lane. You need to merge.

questions.question: What is the main danger shown by this sign?

options.text: One side of your car being higher causes headlight problems.
A tire can be damaged if you drift onto the shoulder.
You may lose control on a wet shoulder.
You may lose control of your vehicle if a wheel drops onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control of your vehicle if a wheel drops onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction areas. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead and will direct traffic. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction
You may go if the way is clear
You must come to a complete stop before going

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction
questions.explanation: This sign means you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers of hazards ahead. This sign alerts you that farm machinery may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers of hazards ahead. This sign tells you lanes are shifting. Follow the new lane direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with the flow of traffic
Slow down for the next 50 miles
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum safe speed you can drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and check for traffic. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly
May pass if you know the road ahead
May pass, but only at night

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs with black markings are regulatory signs. You must obey them. This sign prohibits passing other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn that a school is nearby. Drivers should watch for children and pedestrians. You must obey any crossing guard instructions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs show railroad crossings. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first. You must yield the right-of-way to traffic in the intersection or roadway you are entering.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: From the center lane, which maneuver(s) can you perform?
questions.explanation: This lane is for left turns only. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May either continue through or exit from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane leaves the freeway. If you stay in this lane, you must exit. You can change lanes to continue through the interchange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign requires drivers in the left lane to turn left. They cannot go straight or turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The road ahead is under construction or maintenance work.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead is under construction or maintenance work.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that the road ahead is being worked on. You should slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will curve to the right and then to the left. Slow down so you can safely turn through these curves.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must let pedestrians cross safely. Watch carefully for children and be prepared to stop at school crossings.

questions.question: What do these signs mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to hazards. These object markers warn you about things in the road that you should avoid.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Deer may cross the road here.

questions.correctAnswerText: Deer may cross the road here.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from another road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that traffic from the right is merging into your lane. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow the detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if possible.
Follow the detour to the right if it is convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Orange signs with black lettering mark construction areas. Detour signs show you an alternate route around a road that is blocked by construction. You must follow it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A steep downhill slope is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep downhill slope is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill slope is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that parking is limited. You can park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign is posted at traffic signals. It means you cannot turn right when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Keep your current speed until you reach the reduced speed zone.
Not slow down because traffic will back up.
Reduce your speed only if you want to.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to begin reducing your speed. The new speed limit will start at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces reserved for people with disabled permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
Lanes reserved for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces reserved for people with disabled permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at the speed shown.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed you can legally drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming, so prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready for yellow lights, red lights, and other traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has sharp turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or steering, and keep more distance between your car and the one ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park here at any time.

questions.question: On the freeway, you see a merging traffic sign. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to avoid slowing traffic.
Change lanes if safe to let traffic merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes if safe to let traffic merge.
questions.explanation: On roads with multiple lanes, make room for merging traffic. If no one is driving next to you, move to another lane to help traffic enter.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that construction ahead will change your normal route. Expect to take a different path.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending. If you are in the right lane, you must move left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing.
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must go either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a Y intersection is ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Be ready to stop and yield to other drivers and pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell you to slow down and be ready to stop. You must yield to other drivers and pedestrians. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign tells you to stay alert and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
Only certain turns are allowed from certain lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. HOV lanes are for buses and cars with the driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if other cars are coming.
Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Yield to vehicles and pedestrians in or entering the intersection. Go again when it is safe.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand point upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, it means they plan to turn right. Adjust your driving if you are following a car using this signal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to dangers ahead. This sign warns drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to dangers ahead. This sign tells drivers that the road will soon be divided.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic moves only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: A one-way sign shows that traffic moves in only one direction, the way the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road has three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to dangers ahead. This sign tells drivers to slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to dangers ahead. This sign tells drivers that traffic may come from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.
An extra lane is being added.

questions.correctAnswerText: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers the minimum legal speed. You must not drive slower than the speed shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
Drivers turning left on green must wait for oncoming traffic to pass first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers turning left on green must wait for oncoming traffic to pass first.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with traffic lights. It tells left-turning drivers that they do not have the right-of-way and must wait for oncoming traffic to clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means U-turns are not permitted wherever the sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An extra lane is being added.

questions.correctAnswerText: An extra lane is being added.
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts drivers that an extra lane is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right has one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to roadwork.
Slow down because the road ahead makes a sharp turn.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead makes a sharp turn.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves at a sharp angle. Slow down as you would when making a turn at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows in one direction only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows in one direction only.
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers which direction they must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells drivers that a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. In this case, right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter from your direction. If you see this sign, turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows in one direction only.
Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is entering from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers when it is safe to turn left. Wait for the left turn signal before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has loose gravel.
The road has been sanded for ice.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead has loose gravel.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road ahead is covered with loose gravel. Drive slowly and carefully because your tires will have less grip on gravel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to be careful. The road can become slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot park here. It is a regulation sign that drivers must obey.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at one-way streets to warn you not to enter from the wrong direction. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted near intersections. Do not block the intersection with your vehicle.

questions.question: What is this sign warning you about?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means large trucks are not allowed in this area. It is a regulation sign that drivers must obey.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign directs you to take a different route because the normal road is closed for roadwork.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is controlling traffic ahead in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.
There are trucks on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What type of road condition does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that buggies may be ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that a playground is nearby. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed to use when exiting a highway.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand downward, they are signaling that they plan to stop. Adjust your driving if you see this signal.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive with caution because bicycles regularly cross or travel in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn drivers that a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on or near the road. This sign means there is a school crossing or school zone ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The road ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that workers are on or very close to the road ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a winding road is coming. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns drivers that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Be cautious and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the arrow points. In this case, the road curves sharply to the left. Multiple chevron signs may be placed throughout a curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic and tell drivers what they must do. This sign marks reserved parking spaces for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down when you approach a railroad crossing. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a change in traffic direction or route due to road work. Follow the detour route that is marked.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is showing a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is showing a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead where a road comes in from the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that there is low clearance ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you are entering an area with two-way traffic.

questions.question: This sign prevents:

options.text: Entrance from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrance from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road has one-way traffic. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you that you can either turn right or continue straight in this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a narrow bridge is coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph or less.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to 35 mph or less.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph or less.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph or less.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph or less.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will curve to the right. It tells you to slow down to the safe speed shown, which is 35 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road may be slippery when wet, which makes it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must come to a complete stop and check for pedestrians and other traffic. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means that lane is open and you can use it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after coming to a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs show rules that you must follow. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A 35 mph speed zone starts after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph around the curve.
Curve ahead. Drive at 35 mph or slower.
Stay in the right lane if driving slower than 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead. Drive at 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a curve ahead and recommends driving at 35 mph or slower through the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction zones. These zones are dangerous to drivers and construction workers. This sign tells you that construction is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is near.
Look both ways as you cross.
Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, slow down as you approach the intersection. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians pass. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that the divided highway is about to end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you to drive in the direction shown when turning onto a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you must not drive in that direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign alerts you that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead fits only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn about hazardous conditions ahead. This sign warns you that an upcoming bridge is narrow. Be careful when passing or meeting trucks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit. Always slow down when conditions are poor.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows that there are multiple left turn lanes. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the overpass ahead is low. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this example).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that the road shoulder ahead is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road. Drive with extreme caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign tells you that a detour is 1,000 feet away.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn right.
